content.short: MetaChat is a Web3 intelligent messaging protocol for next-gen social communication.
content.description: MetaChat Protocol redefines social communication through its MetaMessage and MetaNetwork. MetaMessage comprises AI Message and Smart Message. The AI Message leverages GPT-4 and Stable Diffusion to expand interactions from human-to-human to human-to-machine. The Smart Message captures value from daily social activity by embedding smart contracts that realize individual social capital. MetaNetwork is a universal social network built on Matrix, a decentralized protocol, connecting diverse networks to enable seamless messaging.
